assets.name: event-borrow-phone
assets.brief: Opening before a choice: the same protagonist pauses on a quiet Warsaw street while an ordinary man under a streetlight asks to borrow a phone, holding his own dead phone. Hero's phone stays in his pocket; same mandatory hero, style and muted-palette references.

assets.name: event-borrow-phone-return
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Make ONE standalone 16:9 landscape event outcome illustration for Street Life, no text or UI. Reference image 1 is the APPROVED OPENING and establishes the exact two people, wardrobe, residential Warsaw sidewalk, apartment facades, parked cars, black railings, autumn trees and night streetlight. Keep both men's identities and all clothing consistent. Reference 2 is the protagonist IDENTITY sheet: same lean late-thirties man, wavy dark brown hair, short stubble, charcoal hooded jacket, dark sweater, blue jeans, dark boots, exactly one black backpack worn on his back. Reference 3 specifies established detailed realistic painterly rendering, natural anatomy and readable faces; do not copy its bench scene. Reference 4 specifies muted sad calm PALETTE: restrained slate blue-gray, charcoal, gray-brown with softly warm dull amber lamps. Nighttime scene with detailed faces and clothing, not excessively dark or gray-flat, no vivid orange/gold grade or glossy reflections. The stranger must remain the exact same man from image 1: about 45, short sandy-gray hair, clean-shaven, stockier ordinary build, taupe zip jacket and gray top, dark trousers, NO backpack. He is an ordinary polite passerby. The stranger's own dead phone has now been put away out of sight; the ONLY visible phone in this illustration is the protagonist's borrowed plain black smartphone. No brands, logos, writing, montage, inset, captions or speech bubbles. Show the SAFE RETURN after a short call. Medium eye-level two-person framing, hero on left, stranger on right. Stranger with a small grateful smile is handing the intact black phone back to the protagonist; the hero already has a secure grip on it, calm relieved expression and restrained human warmth. Visually clear natural handoff, not slipping, no hovering phone, no fall or damage. Hands anatomically correct, one phone only, their faces recognizable. Match same place and quiet nighttime lighting from opening, no new characters.
